[[Shonan Bellmare|Bellmare Hiratsuka]] | continentalcup1 = [[2000–01 Asian Club Championship|Asian Club Championship]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = [[Júbilo Iwata]] | league topscorer = [[Hwang Sun-hong]] (24 goals) | matches = 240 | total goals = 757 | highest attendance = 51,575 – [[Kashima Antlers|Antlers]] vs. [[Júbilo Iwata|Júbilo]] (May 5) | lowest attendance = 2,411 – [[Vissel Kobe|Vissel]] vs. [[Avispa Fukuoka|Avispa]] (April 17) | average attendance = 11,658 | prevseason = [[1998 J.League|1998]] | nextseason = [[2000 J.League Division 1|2000]] }} '''The 1999 J.League Division 1 season''' was the seventh season of the [[J1 League|J.League Division 1]]. The league began in March 6 and ended in November 27. For this year, the division was contested by 16 teams following the folding of [[Yokohama Flügels]] and the relegation of [[Hokkaido Consadole Sapporo|Consadole Sapporo]] to the newly formed [[1999 J.League Division 2|Division 2]]. The season took place on the [[Shizuoka Prefecture]]. [[Júbilo Iwata]] won the 1st stage and [[Shimizu S-Pulse]] won the 2nd stage. Iwata won the J.League Division 1 title after triumphing on penalty kicks in the [[J.League Championship|Suntory Championship]]. ==Clubs== The following sixteen clubs participated in J.League Division 1 during 1999 season: {|class="wikitable sortable" |- !Club!!colspan="2" |Last season!!Head coach |- |[[Avispa Fukuoka]] |18th |15th |{{flagicon|Japan}} [[Yoshio Kikugawa]] |- |[[Shonan Bellmare|Bellmare Hiratsuka]] |12th |12th |{{flagicon|Japan}} [[Mitsuru Komaeda]] |- |[[Cerezo Osaka]] |9th |13th |{{flagicon|Belgium}} [[René Desaeyere]] |- |[[Gamba Osaka]] |14th |16th |{{flagicon|Japan}} [[Hiroshi Hayano]] |- |[[JEF United Chiba|JEF United Ichihara]] |11th |18th |{{flagicon|Romania}} [[Nicolae Zamfir]] |- |[[Júbilo Iwata]] |1st |2nd |{{flagicon|Japan}} [[Takashi Kuwahara]] |- |[[Kashima Antlers]] |5th |1st |{{flagicon|Brazil}} [[Zico (footballer)|Zico]] |- |[[Kashiwa Reysol]] |10th |8th |{{flagicon|Japan}} [[Akira Nishino (footballer)|Akira Nishino]] |- |[[Kyoto Sanga FC|Kyoto Purple Sanga]] |15th |11th |{{flagicon|Japan}} [[Shu Kamo]] |- |[[Nagoya Grampus|Nagoya Grampus Eight]] |3rd |6th |{{flagicon|Brazil}} [[João Carlos (football manager)|João Carlos]] |- |[[Sanfrecce Hiroshima]] |13th |9th |{{flagicon|Scotland}} [[Eddie Thomson]] |- |[[Shimizu S-Pulse]] |2nd |5th |{{flagicon|England}} [[Steve Perryman]] |- |[[Urawa Red Diamonds]] |7th |3rd |{{flagicon|Netherlands}} [[Aad de Mos]] |- |[[Tokyo Verdy|Verdy Kawasaki]] |6th |17th |{{flagicon|Japan}} [[Hideki Matsunaga]] |- |[[Vissel Kobe]] |17th |14th |{{flagicon|Japan}} [[Ryoichi Kawakatsu]] |- |[[Yokohama F.
